summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier). Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, one parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes, and a separate non-node input test. Ran the new tests together with the existing test/test_path.py: 41 passed. Nothing was committed. mypy, ruff, black, and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-ignore placements and formatting were checked by reading only and are unverified by the checker.
